description: Serve a proof-of-work challenge on a route (optionally for one IP/CIDR and method). Browsers solve it invisibly and keep a clearance cookie; clients that cannot solve it never reach the route. Write action; requires confirmation.

appKey.description: Optional application key. Omit for all apps.

clearanceTtlSeconds.description: How long a solved challenge stays valid, in seconds (default 1800).

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

ip.description: Optional IPv4 address or CIDR. Omit for any IP.

pathPattern.description: Route pattern to protect, for example /api/signup.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_challenge_create
title: Create Challenge
